review_notes: I read the whole file. The closest overlap with an existing Mathlib concept is `Presheaf.imageSieve` and `Subfunctor.sieveOfSection` (Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Subfunctor/Sieves.lean). The file itself proves `imageSieve_eq_sieveOfSection` and `imageSieve_whisker_forget`, both by `rfl`, so the two are already linked. `imageSieve` is stated for presheaves valued in a general concrete category `A` and takes a morphism `f`. `sieveOfSection` is stated for a `Subfunctor` of a type-valued presheaf. They are different representations, and `imageSieve` is the named specialisation used throughout this file. `IsLocallySurjective` is characterised via `Subfunctor.range ... sheafify = ⊤` and does not compete with `Subfunctor`. `Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective` is an `abbrev` over the presheaf version, so it is not a separate concept. `Presieve.FamilyOfElements.localPreimage` wraps `Presheaf.localPreimage` and adds no competing API. I found no independent duplicate of an existing Mathlib, Batteries or core definition. I only grepped uses of `sieveOfSection` and `imageSieve`, so I did not read every caller in full.
